Name: Advanced Social Interactions
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Advanced Social Interactions[/b] is a framework to allow you to do more with NPCs - if you have mods using the framework. Without other mods, you can still chat with NPCs and give gifts.

To open the menu, hold shift and interact with an NPC. If you want it to always trigger (like to prevent accidental gifting), you can set "Always Trigger" to true in the configuration.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.

[/list]

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
